name: expense-tracker/local-aws
description: Local-only tooling for the Compose stack: idempotent bootstrap of the AWS stand-ins (and, later, the S3 events relay and worker runner). Never deployed to AWS.

scripts.test:coverage: mkdir -p build/coverage && rm -f build/coverage/clover.xml && phpunit --testsuite unit --coverage-clover build/coverage/clover.xml --coverage-text

scripts-descriptions.stan: PHPStan at level max with strict rules
scripts-descriptions.cs: PHP-CS-Fixer in dry-run mode (fails on any difference)
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the unit suite and write a Clover report to build/coverage/
scripts-descriptions.coverage:check: Fail if line coverage of src/ is below 80%; an empty report fails too (src/ is never empty here)
